It was pretrained on 128 languages and approximately 436K hours of unlabeled speech data. sources.title: facebook/wav2vec2-xls-r-1b - AI Model Zoo - BimAnt
sources.snippet: XLS-R is Facebook AI's large-scale multilingual pretrained model for speech (the "XLM-R for Speech"). It is pretrained on 436k hours of unlabeled speech, including VoxPopuli, MLS, CommonVoice, BABEL, and VoxLingua107. It uses the wav2vec 2.0 objective, in 128 languages. When using the model make sure that your speech input is sampled at 16kHz.
